value.rationale: Determining all genuine 2-cycles and their 3D Floquet spectra is a structural classification of a published three-dimensional chaotic-map family with numerically observed periodic regimes. The first boundary creates a symmetric 2-cycle, the second creates two additional saddle-focus cycles, and the sharp intermediate Schur threshold distinguishes an actual stable two-cycle window from scalar cycle existence. The computation covers all real states and all positive parameters rather than a toy slice.
